name: fallen dry oak stick
description: a small, fallen, dry stick with reddish-brown bark
details: A small, slender oak stick, snapped from the canopy above, its ends broken and frayed.  Its reddish-brown bark is hairless and dotted with pale lenticels, and a few small, blunt, reddish-brown buds cluster near its tip.  The dry wood is brittle and snaps easily.
keywords: fallen dry oak stick small stick fallen stick dry stick reddish-brown bark pale lenticels blunt reddish-brown buds dry wood
